verses.t: At one time the Buddha was staying at Sāvatthī in the Jeta Grove, Anāthapiṇḍika’s Monastery. At that time the monks from the group of six were receiving almsfood contemptuously, as if wanting to throw it away. … Almsfood is to be received respectfully. If a monk, out of disrespect, receives almsfood contemptuously, as if wanting to throw it away, he commits an offense of wrong conduct. if he is the first offender. The seventh training rule is finished.
“‘I will receive almsfood respectfully,’ this is how you should train.”
